items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Topics 12:1
items.html: (to the question) Nursing is the phase of a middle degree between the lower one and the upper one, by whose help the lower one grows, so that it can ascend to the place of its Mochin that stand there and clothe them permanently. For at the time that the lower one is in the phase of MAN in the upper one, all his NRNHY come out there in completeness, as is known. However, when he is born — meaning that his coarseness is recognized and he is separated from his inclusion in the coupling of the upper one, and he descends to his degree according to his coarseness — he can then no longer receive all the Mochin and descend with them to his degree, but only a small part of them, and all the Mochin remained in the place of the upper one, in his NHY above, at the place where the coupling was. And it is known that the lower one cannot ascend to the place of the upper one before he attains the degree of the upper one. If so, how can ZA ascend to the upper one and receive back from there the Mochin he left there, before he has those Mochin — for those Mochin are what make him into the degree of the upper one? Therefore nursing is needed, meaning that he ascends there temporarily and not permanently. And this temporary ascent is drawn to him from the power of his clothing of the NHY of AA, and he is found with them in one degree. And since the two upper thirds of the NH of AA remained in the HGT of AVI, these two thirds of the NH are discerned as the phase of a middle between the upper one and the lower one, for ZA can ascend to them, as he clothes their phase below in the NHY of AA; hence they are considered like his degree, even while they are above in the HGT of AVI. And he ascends and nurses from them; and since they are in the place of his Mochin, he draws from there his Mochin at the time of his ascent, in the way of the degree, little by little, until he takes from there all his Mochin; and then he becomes like the degree of the upper one, and he can then clothe there permanently. For as long as he has not received all the Mochin in completeness, he cannot clothe there permanently, for he is not yet like the degree of the upper one; hence he ascends there temporarily, which suffices for nursing — meaning, to take a small part of the totality of the Mochin — and immediately descends to his own degree. And these parts that he receives one after another join together with the completion of the reception of all the Mochin, and then he becomes like the upper one and clothes him permanently. And it has been explained that nursing means ascending temporarily and receiving partially from the Mochin, and the ascent is made through the phase of the middle, which are the two thirds of Netzah and Hod of Arich Anpin that remained above in the HGT of AVI. But clothing means that he has all the Mochin attributed to that place that he clothes, and therefore he stands there permanently. (Part 1, Page 144, Item 59).
